definitions.gloss: to strive, to endeavor, to make an effort
definitions.explanation: To consciously try hard to achieve something or maintain a certain state.

examples.japanese: {冷静|れいせい}で{居|い}るように{努|つと}めた。
{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}に{努|つと}めている。
examples.english: I'm making an effort to manage my health.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}{一人|ひとり}ひとりがサービスの{向上|こうじょう}に{努|つと}めなければならない。
examples.english: Every employee must strive to improve service.

notes:
Distinguished from the homophones {勤|つと}める (to work at, to be employed) and {務|つと}める (to serve in a role, to perform a duty). {努|つと}める specifically means to exert oneself or make a deliberate effort.

Typically takes the pattern ～に{努|つと}める or ～ように{努|つと}める.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{改善|かいぜん}に{努|つと}める (strive for improvement)
・{向上|こうじょう}に{努|つと}める (strive for betterment)
・{解決|かいけつ}に{努|つと}める (work toward a resolution)
・{平静|へいせい}を{保|たも}つように{努|つと}める (try to stay composed)
